Before: a chicken wrap (cut in half, about 250 g, ~450 kcal), 6 sushi pieces (3 visible plus others, perhaps ~180 g, ~300 kcal), a brownie (~70 g, ~300 kcal), a latte (~300 ml, ~120 kcal), and ginger and soy sauce.

After: the wrap is eaten, the brownie is eaten, and one sushi piece is left. The latte looks mostly drunk, with foam remaining. Ginger and soy are left untouched.

The sushi in the first photo shows 3 pieces on the plate, and the wrap sits behind them. The sushi is probably a 3-piece portion at ~100 g and ~170 kcal, so eating 2 of 3 gives ~115 kcal and ~65 g (the leftover piece seems to have ginger on it).

The wrap is ~230 g and ~420 kcal. The brownie is ~70 g and ~300 kcal. The latte is about half consumed, perhaps ~150 g and ~70 kcal, though the cup still looks full of foam. I'll count about 60% of it, giving ~200 g and ~80 kcal.

Total kcal: 420 + 115 + 300 + 80 = 915. Total mass: 230 + 65 + 70 + 200 = 565.
